BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
